rules.title: Metric naming
rules.text: Name metrics in snake_case with a base unit suffix (_seconds, _bytes) and end counters with _total.

rules.title: Histograms for latency
rules.text: Record latency with histograms and compute percentiles with histogram_quantile, not averages.

rules.title: rate() over counters
rules.text: Never graph raw counters; use rate() or increase() over a window.

rules.title: Bounded labels
rules.text: Keep label values low-cardinality and never use user IDs or raw URLs as labels.

rules.title: Alert with a for duration
rules.text: Give alert rules a for duration and link each alert to a runbook.

rules.title: Recording rules
rules.text: Precompute expensive dashboard queries with recording rules.
